name: Karaoke
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood karaoke box (Uta no Izumi): an unlimited-singing-time notice, a first day working part-time at the front desk, a room-rate and drink-bar guide, a one-drink-rule notice, a room-manners guide, a lesson in explaining the difference between a karaoke box and a karaoke snack bar, a reservation mix-up and the lesson it teaches, the shop's history of switching from a paper reservation sheet to an app during the year-end-party season, a year-end-party reservation-app guide, a column on the debate behind posting singing videos to SNS, a membership-card dual-record guide, a reflection on balancing noisy banquet parties with solo karaoke, and a thirtieth-anniversary report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
